reason: Pappus scales are a kind of pappus element. PO lists 'pappus scale' as a synonym.
PO lists 'sucker' as a synonym of root-borne shoot system.
A root sucker is a shoot that grows from a root.
A false umbel (pseudo-umbel) is an umbel-like cyme.
French 'fausse ombelle' is the same as 'false umbel'.
Plural of 'fausse ombelle'.
French 'fleur' means flower.
French 'fleurs' means flowers.

PO lists 'lacuna' as a synonym of plant anatomical space.
A flowering branch is a branch. The flowering state is lost, but the bearer is right.
Plural of 'flowering branch'. The bearer is a branch.
French for 'flowering branch'. The bearer is a branch.
Plural of 'rameau florifère'. The bearer is a branch.
'leave' is a typo for 'leaves'. Involucral leaves are involucral bracts.
'pedicelk' is a typo for 'pedicel'.
'Juice' of a fruit is fruit juice, not plant sap. The rule is only safe for vegetative parts.
Herbage is the leafy above-ground shoot, so shoot system fits.
'foliol' is a misspelling of 'foliole', which means leaflet.
Minor veins are veins of the leaf lamina. The vein order is lost, but the bearer is right.
Plural of 'minor vein'.

French for 'petiolar gland'.
This looks like a typo or OCR error for 'inflorescence'. I could not confirm the original text.
A cilium is a marginal hair, which is a trichome.
PO lists 'gland' as a synonym of portion of secretory tissue. It is the only PO term for glands.
The word 'racemose' (raceme-like arrangement of cymes) is lost. A racemose cyme is not a plain cyme. Better to treat it as a cyme inflorescence with a racemose quality, or reject the rule.
Plural of 'racemose cyme'. The racemose arrangement is lost.
'spicate' is an adjective meaning spike-like. It describes the form of an inflorescence and is not a bearer. It should be a quality of the inflorescence.
PO lists 'pitcher' as a synonym of vascular leaf.
Plural of 'pitcher'.
The coat of a bulb is its tunic.
Plural of 'bulb coat'.
A bulb tunic is a tunic.
'outer coat' is also used for seeds, fruits and stems (testa, pericarp). It means tunic only on bulbs and corms.
Microscales are small scale-like trichomes, for example peltate scales.
Plural of 'microscale'.
PO gives hypophysis as a synonym of sporangium base, which holds for moss capsules only. In seed plants it means an embryo cell, and apophysis can mean part of a cone scale.
Plural of 'hypophysis'. Only valid for moss sporophytes.
'apophysis' means sporangium base in mosses. In conifer cones it is the exposed part of the cone scale.
Receptacle scales (chaff, paleae) of Asteraceae are flower bracts. PO lists 'chaff' as a synonym.
Plural of 'receptacle scale'.
French for 'receptacle scale'.
PO lists 'chaff' as a synonym of flower bract. A chaff scale is a receptacle bract.
A pseudospikelet is not a true spikelet, so the 'pseudo' meaning is lost. Mapping it to spikelet states something false about the structure.
Same as 'pseudospikelet'. A pseudo-spikelet is not a spikelet.
'pseudaril' is a variant of 'pseudaril/pseudarillus', an aril-like outgrowth, so arilloid fits.
A pseudarillus is an arilloid.
A false aril is an arilloid.
A cyathophyll is the bract that subtends a cyathium, so it is an inflorescence bract.
